name: retire-the-class
description: Stop patching the same failure class pointwise: find the architecture, data-structure, or substrate change that makes the whole class unrepresentable.

interface.shortDescription: Replace pointwise patches with class-retiring changes.
interface.longDescription: Detects when the same failure class is being patched one member at a time - a second fix for the same kind of failure, a growing trap list - then finds the substrate the class lives on and the architecture or data-structure change that retires it, boarding that change instead of parking it as a note.
defaultPrompt: This is the second time we fixed this kind of bug - retire the class.
This trap list keeps growing; find the substrate change that stops it.
Would this fix hold if a new member of the failure class appeared tomorrow?
